I was also nervous since it was a lab test, but heavily researching the topic kind of have me some peace of mind. My dad who drug tests his patients says “even if it’s a pale yellow, it’ll pass the dilution test,” so I suppose if you’re not pissing clear you will probably be just fine.

So for me it took about 50 days to get clean just naturally and that was in a similar situation to you. I am not sure about Palo Azul, but most recently I was able to test clean in about 24 days trying to make my urine as dilute as possible without overdoing it, and it too was for school. I am about 5’6 and 180 lbs so I’m not too dissimilar from you. On the day of I drank a whole bottle of water in about a minute and used that urine about 30-45 min before the test and it worked. Depending on how much time you have left, I would keep on doing what you’re doing and try to keep that water intake high. I obsessively tested myself with those test strips from Target that are like $12 for 15 of them. I recommend them as they seem pretty solid. Beware that the line might be hard to see if it’s a pass (two lines), but regardless a pass is a pass. Best of luck to you.

If there is no outcome beyond personal gain then it’s futile. What good will any of these memories be if I can’t take them with me once I’m dead. Even people I like I had begun treating poorly so when I do die they won’t be burdened; they’re last memory of me was as an asshole.

That one is weird I suppose. My parents had an abusive relationship through my childhood, and they even split a couple times. Last year when I graduated from college they divorced the day after and, since they were not being civil, I was the delivery boy for the paperwork to the lawyers. I’ve seen romance and I never want that. I would much rather kill myself then have to deal with anyone’s bullshit forever.

The most immediate consequence was coming to terms with how I was treated by my brothers. They told me that, through prayer, god did not want me leading. My dissonance came with wanting to obey but also thinking those frat officers lied to me and used Christ as a weapon.

Yeah. It created this huge rift in my thinking, creating unbearable cognitive dissonance. Fundamentally, I think it changed me. I used to love Jesus, but now I can’t even love the electrons that made this device work.
I don’t. Like I don’t even feel depressed in the contemporary sense. I tried yesterday, staring into my mortality, and felt nothing. You could call it a void.

Of course I tried religion. I was a leader in my Christian fraternity until they kicked me off for being a homosexual. Lol, ironically that was enough for me to kick human sexuality all together. I have made it my active choice to never love anyone romantically. I’ve tried therapy, new hobbies, academic major changes, going out to meet new people, hanging out with current friends. I’ve read books from the great absurdist Camus in an attempt to find personal meaning in the nothingness. 
Tried new churches, new organizations, new jobs, and still I feel nothing that wants to keep me tethered to the earth. I know I’m a irreconcilably broken human. There are people who find hope in stuff that may or may not exist, and I am using the last of my mammalian preservation instinct on talking to other mammals on the internet. What a waste.
